3. जैन धर्म का सबसे बड़ा केंद्र चम्पा नगर था।

Open market operations of the RBI refer to the buying and selling of government bonds.

Gandhiji started the Civil Disobedience Movement during the viceroyalty of Lord Irwin.

Florence Nightingale is associated with the Crimean War.

The Glorious Revolution in England occurred in 1688.

2. भारत निर्यात-आयात बैंक की स्थापना 1 जनवरी 1982 को हुई थी।
EXIM Bank of India was established on 1 January 1982.

3. नयचंद्र जैन तीर्थंकरों में संस्कृत के विद्वान माने जाते हैं।
Nayachandra was a scholar among Jain figures.

4. सूर्यकांत त्रिपाठी ‘निराला’ को ‘महाप्राण’ कहा जाता है।
Suryakant Tripathi ‘Nirala’ is called ahapran.

5. लिटमस लाइकेन से प्राप्त गुलाबी रंग का उदासीन अर्क है।
Litmus is a neutral pink extract obtained from lichens.

6. विधान परिषद् के 1/3 सदस्य स्थानीय निकायों से चुने जाते हैं।
One-third of Legislative Council members are elected by local bodies.

7. सबसे बड़ा विषाणु चेचक का होता है।
The largest virus is that of smallpox.

8. हड़प्पा सभ्यता का सबसे पूर्वी स्थल आलमगीरपुर है।
Alamgirpur is the easternmost Harappan site.

9. ‘अष्टाध्यायी’ संस्कृत व्याकरण से संबंधित ग्रंथ है।
‘Ashtadhyayi’ is related to Sanskrit grammar.

10. तुंगभद्रा नदी कृष्णा नदी की सहायक नदी है।
Tungabhadra is a tributary of the Krishna River.

Salima Tete was appointed captain of the Indian women’s hockey team for the Women’s Asian Champions Trophy 2026.

Bhopal, Madhya Pradesh, will host the Women’s Asian Champions Trophy, scheduled from 19 to 28 November 2026.

M. John Harrison was awarded the Booker Prize 2026 for the novel ‘The End of Everything’.

The theme of World Science Day for Peace and Development 2026 is “Common Ground Through Science Diplomacy”.

The traditional New Year festival ‘Bestu Varas’, celebrated in November 2026, is associated with Gujarat.

The traditional festival ‘Ningol Chakouba’, celebrated in November 2026, is primarily associated with Manipur.

Renowned sitar maestro Pandit Manilal Nag, who passed away in November 2026, belonged to the Bishnupur Gharana of Hindustani classical music.

A two-day national event on agricultural biodiversity conservation and climate-resilient agriculture was held in Bhubaneswar, Odisha, in November 2026.
